## 描述

Caterpillar cabin air filter under OE number 500-0957 (CAT 5000957), catalogued in the cabin-filtration category for construction-machinery cabs. The source confirms the Caterpillar OE number and the machinery application but publishes no dimensions, media type or ISO 16890 efficiency class. Machine-cab duty is dust-heavy, so particle-holding behaviour matters more than in passenger-vehicle duty. Our advice: confirm the exact Cat machine model and whether the housing takes a single-piece or two-piece filter, then request the spec sheet for dimensions and efficiency. Verify fitment against the OE drawing before a bulk commitment.
